items.title: Pay invoice for hedge trimmer purchase
items.quote: Zahlungsziel: 7 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum, netto ohne Abzug.
items.computation: This is a private invoice (not from an authority), so ordinary §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB counting applies. The invoice date is Wed 17.12.2025; the day of the event is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), so counting starts on 18.12.2025. 7 days later is Wed 24.12.2025 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). 24.12.2025 is a working day (not a weekend or a public holiday in NW - Christmas Eve is not a statutory holiday), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Due date: 24.12.2025.

warnings: The IBAN given for payment (DE23 3705 0198 0009 9001 12) is well-formed and belongs to Musterbank AG in Germany, but a valid IBAN does not confirm it belongs to Beispiel Versand GmbH — compare it with the account used on any earlier invoice or the company's official website before paying.

The invoice states delivery occurred the same day as invoicing („Ihre Lieferung erfolgt heute“ on 17.12.2025) despite the order being placed only two days earlier on 15.12.2025 — worth double-checking that the goods were actually received before paying.
